page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r7a.32xlarge is a memory-optimized instance built on the KVM hypervisor. It is powered by the x86_64 AMD EPYC 7T83 processor, providing 128 dedicated vCPUs clocked at a base frequency of 2.55 GHz. The instance integrates 1024.0 GB of system memory, maintaining an 8.0 GB per vCPU ratio suitable for memory-demanding enterprise deployments.

The hardware configuration excludes integrated local disk storage, requiring external cloud block storage for persistent data requirements. Network performance features a baseline throughput of 32 Gbps. The architecture does not incorporate dedicated GPU acceleration hardware and does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From a qualitative efficiency perspective, the instance provides high density by consolidating 128 compute threads with a terabyte of RAM on a single host. This configuration delivers resource efficiency for workloads that require large continuous memory address spaces without the multi-node overhead of distributed clusters.

Alibaba Cloud ecs.r7a.32xlarge is engineered for large-scale in-memory databases, SAP HANA, distributed caching systems, high-volume transactional processing, and memory-intensive enterprise application platforms.
